# Storage Location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:StorageLocation`](gmeow-StorageLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StorageLocation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A locus where digital objects reside — a cloud-storage folder, an object-store bucket, a filesystem path, a content-addressed store, or a physical disk. Its medium is a value ([`gmeow:storageMedium`](../properties/gmeow-storageMedium.md)); a physical device may sit at a geographic [`gmeow:physicalPlace`](../properties/gmeow-physicalPlace.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:StorageLocation`](gmeow-StorageLocation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for where digital bytes reside — a cloud folder, object-store bucket, filesystem path, content-addressed store, or physical disk — as the structured form of [`gmeow:storedIn`](../properties/gmeow-storedIn.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the geographic site of the device (link that via [`gmeow:physicalPlace`](../properties/gmeow-physicalPlace.md) to a [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md)) and avoid for an online venue ([`VirtualLocation`](gmeow-VirtualLocation.md)); a storage location is where bytes sit, not where people meet.

### How to use

- Type as [`StorageLocation`](gmeow-StorageLocation.md), set the functional [`gmeow:storageMedium`](../properties/gmeow-storageMedium.md), give [`gmeow:storagePath`](../properties/gmeow-storagePath.md) / [`gmeow:storageService`](../properties/gmeow-storageService.md), and point [`gmeow:physicalPlace`](../properties/gmeow-physicalPlace.md) at the holding [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md) when the device is geographically located.

### Examples

- ex:bucket a [`gmeow:StorageLocation`](gmeow-StorageLocation.md); [`gmeow:storageMedium`](../properties/gmeow-storageMedium.md) [`gmeow:storageMediumObjectStore`](../individuals/gmeow-storageMediumObjectStore.md); [`gmeow:storagePath`](../properties/gmeow-storagePath.md) "s3://corpus/2026/".
